dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Convex anterior margin rising at approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal midline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.8:1 ratio of maximum basal width to vertical height.
